# Baselines for task `mul` (NOT entries)

Reference points for the (area, depth) frontier at the task's scoring flow
(`score/score.py`, Yosys 0.53 + ABC). None of these is an svGolf entry:

* `yosys_mul.sv`: `assign p = a * b;`, Yosys's own multiplier. It violates
  the task's banlist (run-time `*`); scored with the banlist lifted, as the
  baseline to beat.
* `dadda_rc_<N>.sv`, `dadda_ks_<N>.sv`: Dadda trees generated by
  `gen_dadda.py N [--final ks]` (column compression with full and half
  adders to height 2, then a ripple-carry or Kogge-Stone final adder),
  bitwise operators only (they pass the banlist). `gen_dadda.py --write`
  regenerates all six files here and `--check` verifies them (`tests/run.py`
  does). Each file is a flat netlist
  for ONE width: it keeps the task header, but at any other `N` it is wrong,
  so it cannot satisfy the for-all-`N` statement. No proof.

Validation (Verilator, `tests/mul/validate/sim.py DESIGN --width N`; Icarus 12 before 10/29):
`dadda_*_4` and `dadda_*_8` exhaustively, `dadda_*_16` and `dadda_*_32` on
20 000 random vectors plus corners, no mismatch (the `4`-bit files were
generated for that check only and are not kept here). `tests/run.py` re-runs
`N = 8` exhaustively and `N = 16, 32` on 2 000 random vectors (20 000 with
`--full`), and `yosys_mul.sv` on `sim.py`'s quick plan.

| design | N = 8 | N = 16 | N = 32 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `yosys_mul.sv` | 468.637 / 30 | 2081.227 / 59 | 8639.254 / 110 |
| `dadda_rc_<N>.sv` | 445.978 / 29 | 1953.585 / 61 | 8153.020 / 125 |
| `dadda_ks_<N>.sv` | 484.290 / 24 | 2076.510 / 48 | not scored: Yosys + ABC exceeded `score.py`'s 1800 s limit |
| reference (`tasks/mul/reference/mul_n.sv`, proved) | 447.976 / 40 | 1962.576 / 88 | 8191.648 / 184 |

(area in NAND2 GE / depth in gates; every number, with its gate mix, is in
`tests/expected.json`, which `tests/run.py` checks.) The pinned flow could not finish `dadda_ks_32.sv` within
`score.py`'s 1800 s Yosys timeout (ABC alone ran over 25 minutes on it), so
that cell is empty; at that size the flow itself is a limit worth knowing.

At `N = 16` the Pareto frontier of these four is Dadda + ripple (smallest)
and Dadda + Kogge-Stone (shallowest; it also beats Yosys's own `*` on both
axes); the proved reference is within 0.5 % of the smallest area but 27
gates deeper.

Reproduce:

```bash
python3 tests/mul/baselines/gen_dadda.py 16 > /tmp/d.sv
python3.12 score/score.py /tmp/d.sv --top mul_n --param N=16
```
